claude-opus-4.8.name: Claude 4.8 Opus
claude-opus-4.8.tokenizer_drift_warning: Claude Opus 4.8 inherits the Opus 4.7 tokenizer baseline (re-baselined 2026-04): the same input text can yield 1.0x to 1.35x tokens vs prior Claude families (Sonnet 4.6, Opus <=4.6). Re-baseline cost + latency budgets; cached prompts from earlier models may overshoot the context window. See packages/routing/src/three-tier-router.ts ESTIMATE_INFLATION.

runway-gen-4.name: Runway Gen-4
runway-gen-4.pricingNote: Per auto-routing-spec.md §4 Pool B video slot. ~$0.05/second at 720p. Pro+ caps at 60 sec/mo (~$3 COGS); Max caps at 5 min/mo. Sora-2 unavailable as of April 2026 — Runway Gen-4 is the chosen replacement.
